messages.content: What color was the man dressed in when he emerged through the hole in the roof?
Green.
What did Dorothy see the stranger do when he reached the roof's edge?
He walked on the air.
Why did the children blend in at the balloon's arrival?
Same size as the Mangaboos.
Where was Eureka resting while the crowds looked up at the balloon?
On the buggy seat.
What rule does the Prince give for sprouting Mangaboos?
They must be planted at once.
Which bush has produced the country's leaders since long ago?
The Royal Bush.
Where does a Mangaboo's outfit come from before the person is picked?
It grew on their bodies.
What did the group compare the writhing tangle of vines to when they looked down?
A nest of snakes.
What sound broke the quiet on the path toward the first cottage in Voe?
A bird twittering.
What was the Wizard's guess about why the wooden creatures delayed killing them?
For a ceremony.
What did the kitten liken the mouths of the creatures in the round cavern to?
Coal-scuttles.
How far back in years did the dragonette claim its ancestry went?
About twenty thousand years.
What title went with Ozma's offer of a permanent home to the Wizard?
Official Wizard.
What plant did Jim munch when the Lion and Tiger spoke with him?
Clover.
What was the number of lawyers in fairyland when they were preparing for the trial?
None.
What gift did the girl get from the Braided Man after bringing the blue ribbon?
A box of rustles.
